snippet.title: Valorborn: Official Early Access Launch Trailer
snippet.description:
Enjoy the Early Access launch trailer for Valorborn, the upcoming single-player medieval fantasy RPG sandbox where you can become whomever you want to be as you attempt to survive this world alone or with a party of customized characters. Valorborn will be available in Steam Early Access on April 15. Wishlist it if you're interested: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3372530/Valorborn/

#IGN #Gaming
